title: Cannabis News and Culture
metaDescription: Michigan cannabis news and culture: the history of prohibition and legalization, heritage months and holidays, and what new rules mean for adult shoppers.

hero.lead: Cannabis has a long history and a culture all its own. News & Culture covers both: how prohibition began, the people and movements behind legalization, heritage months and holidays, and the laws and votes that shape cannabis today. Articles about Michigan explain what the rules mean for adult shoppers and link to the official sources.
